messages.subject: I spoke to her
messages.body:
She sent me her verification receipt. Hers says 0001842. Mine says 0002917. We had separate recovery addresses before all this.

On screen the names look the same to me. Support keeps closing her case as a duplicate. I’d like them to see what index-09 kept of the forms we each filled in.

messages.subject: We have the records
messages.body:
I sent her the export. She laughed when I put the two names side by side. Then she asked me to send the numbered version too, so nobody could copy the wrong one into the case.

Support had been telling us one account needed to be deleted. We've sent them both verification records. We'd like to keep both accounts.

Thank you.

- Mira

messages.subject: I reopened both cases
messages.body:
The originals came through. I reopened the appeals under 0001842 and 0002917. The queue team has both rows. I can only see one in review.

Both are on appeals-04. I’m holding off asking either owner to fill anything in again.
